facts.fact: JJ 沿 Otley Road 往市中心赶，在化装参加 Otley Run 酒吧巡游的学生中间穿行
facts.anchor: JJ hurried down Otley Road towards the city centre, weaving between the students in fancy dress

facts.fact: JJ 自认把钱包落在麦当劳桌上、留在 Emily 面前是愚蠢的
facts.anchor: He was a fool to leave his wallet on the table in McDonald’s with Emily fucking Pierce.

facts.fact: 他不知道 Emily 偷走那两张十镑时有没有翻看他的卡
facts.anchor: whether she had looked at his cards when she’d nicked those two tenners

facts.fact: 他不该把驾照留在钱包里，因为他还没用新名字补办
facts.anchor: He should never have left his driving licence in there

facts.fact: 本地报纸只登过一篇报道，用他的真名 Liam Craig，且没有配照片
facts.anchor: only one article had appeared in the local paper, referring to him by his real name, Liam Craig

facts.fact: Arthur 对 JJ 说今晚那个赌局就算了
facts.anchor: We’ll have to forget about the bet tonight.

facts.fact: Harry 拍着 JJ 的肩说，他们觉得 Emily 很好上手
facts.anchor: They think she’s easy, that’s all.

facts.fact: 进了 Townhouse，JJ 给其他人买了一圈 shot，并观察他们怎么喝
facts.anchor: he bought the others a round of shots and studied how they drank them

facts.fact: 叙述者点明 Liam Craig 五年前因重罪被捕、被起诉并定罪
facts.anchor: Liam Craig, who was arrested, prosecuted and convicted of a serious crime five years earlier.

facts.fact: JJ 想，如果要把 Emily 交给他们才能留在圈子里，那就这样吧
facts.anchor: If delivering Emily to them was what it took, then so be it
